# The Proposal On The Night Of The Funeral - Script

## Scene 1 - INT. OFFICE - DUSK (about 30 seconds)

Lena Ward opens a gilded invitation. Her fingers stop on the date: November 18.

She tears the invitation in half, drops it into the trash, then reaches down, retrieves it, and folds it carefully into a drawer.

VICTOR (V.O.)
Lena. I hope you come.

## Scene 2 - INT. LENA'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (about 40 seconds)

Lena tucks the blanket around her daughter. Her phone rings.

LENA
Hello?

TEACHER (PHONE)
Ms. Ward, an uncle picked Nora up for a little while today. You knew about that, right?

Lena's hand tightens around the phone.

LENA
Yes. Thank you.

She hangs up. Her hand shakes. She looks at her sleeping daughter.

## Scene 3 - INT. BANK SAFE-DEPOSIT ROOM - NIGHT (about 40 seconds)

Lena loads documents, cash, and her husband's letter into a bag.

GUARD (O.S.)
Ms. Ward, time is up.

LENA
One more minute.

She touches the letter once and inhales.

## Scene 4 - EXT. CLIFF ROAD - DAWN (about 70 seconds)

Lena drives. Victor's headlights grow in the rearview mirror.

Her daughter sleeps in the back seat.

Lena presses the accelerator. The cliff road opens ahead.

She looks once more into the mirror, at her daughter, and smiles.

The car surges forward.
